hints.title: Extremes Convergence Bound
hints.text: The best possible score adjustment moves the minimum element upward by k and the maximum element downward by k.

hints.title: Span Reduction by 2K
hints.text: The total spread between the extreme values is reduced by up to twice k.

hints.title: Non-Negative Truncation
hints.text: If twice k is larger than the original spread, all elements can become identical, yielding zero. Return max(0, max(nums) - min(nums) - 2 * k).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass finding maximum and minimum elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying different offset assignments on intermediate elements is redundant since only extremes dictate the range.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct calculation based on span reduction max - min - 2 * k.
